major_cooldowns.name: Arcane Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your primary cooldown: build to 20 Arcane Salvo stacks with Arcane Blast, then send it and take the 35% spell damage and the mana refill for 15 seconds, delaying it only for an imminent Time Warp, a burst mechanic, or incoming adds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 365350 is the cast; 365362 is the buff aura. Base cooldown listed as 1.5 min in the tooltip, guide states 90 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of the Magi
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Apply it right after Arcane Surge and again the moment it comes back 45 seconds later, always on a target that survives all 12 seconds, since it has exactly half Arcane Surge's cooldown and any delay pushes your next Surge back.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 321507 is the current cast id; 210824 and 210833 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Presence of Mind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it to keep casting Arcane Blast while moving, or to rebuild from under 2 Arcane Charges when you have no Clearcasting and Arcane Orb is not close to a charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Evocation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it only under 10% mana with Arcane Surge down, Touch of the Magi not active and Arcane Surge more than 10 seconds away, and cancel the channel once you are back near full.

major_cooldowns.name: Mirror Image
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it just before the pull so the images are free damage during your opener, and in combat to dump threat or soak a hit.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Follow the raid's assigned timing; with no call, send it right after combat starts so it covers everyone's opening cooldowns, but only when targets stay up for the full 40 seconds.

defensives.name: Prismatic Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep it rolling ahead of magic damage: it absorbs a chunk of your health and cuts magic damage taken by 15% for a full minute.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Set it at full health before a known hit and recast within 10 seconds to snap back to that health and position.
defensives.id_note: 342245 is the initial cast with the 1 min cooldown; 342247 is the return cast, 342246 the aura.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Drops all threat and makes you untargetable for 20 seconds, so use it to shed a stacking debuff or an add that has fixated you.
defensives.id_note: 110960 is the id observed in Casts; the 120 s base cooldown comes from the 110959 row.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for 10 seconds for a hit that would otherwise kill you, accepting that you cannot cast or move during it.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: Takes 70% off all damage for 6 seconds while you keep casting, which is the pick for scripted raid damage you have to stand in.

rules.description: Open Arcane Blast, Arcane Surge, Touch of the Magi
rules.action: Build to 20 Arcane Salvo stacks with Arcane Blast, fire any 15 second or longer stat effects, then Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi. Skip the Salvo build only when the pull demands instant burst.

rules.description: Touch of the Magi follows every Arcane Surge
rules.action: Cast Touch of the Magi inside every Arcane Surge window so the 12 second accumulation runs under the 35% damage buff, then Arcane Barrage into it with about 5 seconds of Surge left.
Spend Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges with 20 or more Arcane Salvo stacks (25 as Sunfury). Barraging on low Charges throws away both its damage and the mana reset.
Follow Arcane Barrage with Arcane Orb while you hold Clearcasting to rebuild Charges and Salvo, and otherwise use Orb at 0 to 2 Arcane Charges rather than sitting on the charge.

rules.description: Arcane Explosion only on big packs
rules.action: Only use Arcane Explosion to rebuild Charges under 2 stacks on 4 or more targets; below that, Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse is the filler.

source_summary: Arcane runs on a 90 second Arcane Surge, with Touch of the Magi applied inside every Surge window and again on its own 45 second cooldown, which is exactly half of Surge's, so any Touch delay drags the next Surge with it. The opener builds 20 Arcane Salvo stacks with Arcane Blast, stacks 15 second or longer trinkets, racials and potions ahead of Arcane Surge, then Touch of the Magi. Between cooldowns the loop is building 4 Arcane Charges and maximum Arcane Salvo, then spending both with Arcane Barrage, using Arcane Orb and Clearcasting to rebuild and Arcane Surge or Evocation to recover mana.
